notes.title: Demo version is Out Now!
notes.notes: [p][b][i]Destroyer in Miraculous Storm.[/i] Demo version is out Now![/b][/p][p][/p][p]You can experience following content in Demo version:[/p][list][*][p]Main gameplay up to Stage 3 (with 4 different difficulties available).[/p][/*][*][p]3 main characters.[/p][/*][*][p]Music Room (basic function)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Demo version does not represent the quality of the final version.[/b][/p][p]If you have any comments or suggestions, feel free to post on the Steam discussion.[/p][p]We look forward to your feedback![/p][p][/p][p][u]幻缘制作组 Presents[/u][/p]

notes.title: It's a long time! Touhou DiMS store page is ready!
notes.notes: [p]Sorry for the long wait![/p][p]After 6 years, [i]Destroyer in Miraculous Storm.[/i] is finally ready to say hello to all of you![/p][p][/p][p]This is our first Touhou Project bullet hell STG fan game. We've worked hard to deliver a smooth and satisfying bullet pattern experience, while keeping the system as simple as possible.[/p][p]We also hope you'll enjoying the story that Reimu and her friends encounter this time.[/p][p][/p][p]And more exciting...[b]you can now add it to your wish list![/b][/p][p]But that's not all -- We are delighted to announce:[/p][p][b]The Demo Version of [i]Destroyer in Miraculous Storm.[/i] will officially launch at July 25 14:00 (UTC+0)![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Are you ready to embark on a wonderful adventure in the rain?[/p][p]Look forward to seeing you again![/p][p][/p][p][u]幻缘制作组 Presents[/u][/p]
